o1: Predicted to enable calmodulin binding activity and protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in epithelial tube morphogenesis; positive regulation of endocytic recycling; regulation of Golgi organization; negative regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis; positive regulation of microtubule severing during meiosis; and sarcomere organization. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be part of protein-containing complex. Is expressed in body-wall muscle; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and reproductive system. Interacts with GCK-1; FARL-11; LET-92; CCM-3; and SLMP-1. Orthologous to several human genes including STRN3 (striatin 3).
